# Duti Heritage

> Premium Fashion & Luxury Apparel based in India.

## About Us
Duti Heritage is an authentic Indian ethnic and luxury wear brand. We specialize in pure cotton, premium nightwear, unstitched suits, and handcrafted apparel.
- **Website:** [Duti Heritage Official Site](https://www.dutiheritage.co.in)

- **GSTIN:** 06ANFPR1728Q2ZF

## Policies
- **Shipping:** [Shipping Policy](https://www.dutiheritage.co.in/shipping) - Free shipping on prepaid orders. Pan India delivery in 3-7 working days. COD available with a partial advance payment. Dispatch within 48-72 hours.
- **Returns & Exchanges:** [Exchange Policy](https://www.dutiheritage.co.in/return-exchange) - No refunds. Size exchanges and defective product exchanges are available within 24 hours of delivery.
